description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2029/12, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420202 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific modifications to land parcel records, including changes to ownership details, property extents, parcel numbers, and encumbrances/mortgages. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
